strongestfacialcues.A: More angular facial outlines, prominent straight noses, firmer brow ridges, defined cheekbones, narrower lips and sharper chins.
strongestfacialcues.B: Generally softer cheeks and jawlines, fuller lower faces, rounder nose tips and less severe brow contours. Several share reddish hair and similar cheek-to-mouth proportions.

whetherclothesinfluencedjudgment: Slightly: repeated white veils could have encouraged grouping, although facial structure was primary. Garment colors were not treated as family markers. Hair color and texture also influenced the judgment.
